clusters.headline: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin Resigns Over AI Exam Cheating Chaos
aiSummaryBullets: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned following widespread concerns regarding the integrity of university and college entrance examinations.
The Ministry of Education has filed criminal complaints against five students suspected of using smart devices to cheat during the recent CSAT.

clusters.headline: KOSPI Drops Three Percent Amid Ongoing AI Sector Sell-Off
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index dropped 3.31 percent to close at 4,708.54 points.
The decline follows a broader global downturn in stocks related to artificial intelligence.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Announces Cabinet And Security Reshuffle
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung appointed new heads for the Foreign and Unification ministries.
Former Justice Minister Kang Kum-sil was selected to lead the National Intelligence Service as the first female director.

clusters.headline: South Korean Rival Parties Clash Over Chief Justice Impeachment
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party is pursuing the impeachment of the Supreme Court chief justice.
A national body representing judges has formally criticized the political push for impeachment.

clusters.headline: Ateez Reaches Fourth Billboard 200 Top Spot With New Album Release
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop group Ateez achieved their fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart with their latest release.
The group's 15th EP, titled Golden Hour: Part. 6, reached the top position shortly after their previous release.

clusters.headline: South Korean Regulators Intervene Amid Sharp Stock Market Sell-Off
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean authorities plan to activate a stock market stabilization fund following significant declines in the Kospi and Kosdaq indices.
Financial regulators announced that daily limits on share buybacks will be removed for a three-month period to encourage market stability.

clusters.headline: Six Injured After Bus Crashes Near Hongik University Station
aiSummaryBullets: A bus hit a sidewalk in Seoul's Hongik University area on Saturday.
The incident occurred after a collision involving another bus and a car.

clusters.headline: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il Addresses Volatile South Korea Market
aiSummaryBullets: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il stated that the government has prepared contingency measures beyond existing stock market stabilization funds.
The KOSPI index experienced a five percent decline, prompting government intervention to address market instability.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Sees Approval Rating Increase To 37 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung recorded a 37.3 percent approval rating in a poll conducted by Realmeter.
The president's job performance rating increased by 0.9 percentage points over the past week.

clusters.headline: Samsung Securities Reports Data Breach Affecting Over 8,000 Clients
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Securities confirmed that the personal information of 8,241 clients was leaked.
The brokerage firm identified the breach after discovering unauthorized access to its customer response system.

clusters.headline: Stray Kids Member Felix Promotes South Korea Hanbok Campaign
aiSummaryBullets: Stray Kids member Felix modeled traditional hanbok designs for the South Korean government's annual Hanbok Wave initiative.
The campaign aims to promote South Korean cultural identity as the government prepares for new legislation to grow the domestic hanbok industry.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Visits AI Data Center Project In Ulsan
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung visited an artificial intelligence data center currently under construction in the city of Ulsan.
The president emphasized the importance of rapid development to maintain competitiveness within the global artificial intelligence industry.

clusters.headline: Singer Mark From NCT Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
aiSummaryBullets: The former NCT member Mark will release his new studio album titled Windmill next month.
The upcoming album includes the lead single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and previously released B-sides.

clusters.headline: South Korean Coast Guard Locates Sunken Fishing Boat Haegwangho
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities identified the sunken hull of the fishing boat Haegwangho on the seabed off the western coast of Taean.
The discovery occurred during the fifth day of search operations following the vessel's reported disappearance last Wednesday.

clusters.headline: Kim Jong-un Claims North Korea Seeks No Regional Dominance
aiSummaryBullets: Kim Jong-un stated that North Korea has no intentions regarding regional expansion or dominance.
The North Korean leader characterized the nation's ongoing military buildup as a legitimate exercise of sovereign self-defense.

clusters.headline: South Korea Exports Double In November On Record Chip Shipments
aiSummaryBullets: South Korea's total export value reached 77.4 billion dollars between November 1 and 20.
The data from the Korea Customs Service shows a substantial increase from the 38.4 billion dollars recorded during the same period last year.

clusters.headline: Samsung And SK Hynix Shares Plummet Amid Global Tech Market Slump
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares recorded significant losses during Friday trading on the Korea Exchange.
The decline follows a broader Wall Street technology sell-off and investor apprehension regarding the sustainability of the AI market.

clusters.headline: Kim A-Lim Ties For Seventh At LPGA CME Group Tour Championship
aiSummaryBullets: Kim A-Lim finished in a tie for seventh place at the CME Group Tour Championship in Naples, Florida.
The golfer concluded the 2026 LPGA Tour season with an 18-under 270 score over the four-day event.

clusters.headline: NPA Commissioner General Kim Jong-Chul Vows To Earn Public Trust
aiSummaryBullets: Kim Jong-chul assumed the role of Commissioner General for the National Police Agency.
The appointment follows recent legal reforms that removed investigative powers from prosecutors.

clusters.headline: South Korea Requests Qatar Prioritize LNG Supplies After Disruption
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan met with Qatari Minister of State for Energy Affairs Saad Sherida al-Kaabi in Seoul.
The South Korean government requested prioritized delivery of liquefied natural gas from Qatar after current disruptions conclude.
